about: Modern Problems Require Modern Solutions is a still of Dave Chappelle in a dark suit and red tie, standing in front of a stone building and pointing at the camera with a knowing, almost smug look while the yellow subtitle delivers the line. He looks like a man who has just explained a brilliant plan that is actually a terrible shortcut. That is how the meme is used: to present a lazy, absurd or rule-bending workaround as if it were a sophisticated piece of problem solving. The more ridiculous the fix, the more Chappelle's confident pointing sells it.
origin: The frame comes from a sketch on Chappelle's Show, the Comedy Central sketch series Dave Chappelle hosted in the early 2000s. It resurfaced as a reaction image in the late 2010s.
usage:
This template has one text box at the top, above the photo. Write the problem and the hack together, or just the hack, so that the printed subtitle reads as the verdict: "phone at 1% and no charger? use the laptop as a power bank". The yellow line on the image is the punchline, so don't repeat it.

It lands best when the solution technically works but nobody should be proud of it: taping a phone to a ceiling fan for step counts, renaming a file to final_final_v3, closing a bug ticket as "works on my machine". Keep it to one or two short lines so the face still dominates.
ideas: can't fix the bug? delete the test
no clean bowls? eat cereal out of a mug
can't find the TV remote? control it from your phone
lag in ranked? blame the router out loud
forgot your umbrella? shopping bag hat
too lazy to cook? pancakes for dinner
aka: Modern Problems Require Modern Solutions Meme
